## **TZ1.3. SECTION 3 -- REGULATORY RESULT**

### **TZ1.3.1. DFS NET GAIN/LOSS ON ACTIVITY IN THE GERMANY TERMINAL CHARGING ZONE IN 2025**

DFS reported a net loss of -2.6 M€, as a combination of a gain of +1.0 M€ arising from the cost sharing mechanism, with a loss of -1.8 M€ arising from the traffic risk sharing mechanism and a loss of -1.7 M€ relating to financial incentives.

### **TZ1.3.2. DFS OVERALL REGULATORY RESULT (RR) ON ACTIVITY IN THE TERMINAL CHARGING ZONE** 

Ex-post, the overall RR, taking into account the net loss from the terminal activity mentioned above (-2.6 M€) and the actual RoE (+14.5 M€), amounts to +12.0 M€ (3.6% of the terminal revenues). The resulting ex-post rate of return on equity is 5.8%, which is lower than the 8.2% planned in the PP. See also Note 1 below.

### **TZ1.3.3. NOTES**

#### **TZ1.3.3.1. NOTE 1**

The ex-post RR does not take into account the application of a lower unit rate in 2025 as per Art. 29.6 (the loss in revenues corresponds to -19.6 M€ for 2025).

#### **TZ1.3.3.2. NOTE 2**
